hero.badge: Direct Trade · Small Batch Roasting · Sustainable Sourcing
hero.heading: Crafting Extraordinary Coffee Experiences From Farm to Cup
hero.subheading: We partner directly with family-owned micro-lots around the world to roast exceptional specialty coffees with transparent origins and meticulous craft.

paragraphs: Lumina was founded in 2019 with a simple mission: celebrate the tireless producers behind the world's most nuanced coffees. By cutting out commodity middlemen, we pay an average of 240% above fair trade minimums directly to harvesting cooperatives.
Every batch is roast-profiled on our vintage cast-iron drum roasters to unlock distinct fruit, floral, and chocolate notes inherent to the varietal and terroir.

items.name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Gedeb
